$comment: PLAT-838 M6 corpus: real FR/NFR/StR statements from agent-ix repos under ~/dev (quire-rs, quoin, quire-specification, quire-spec-language). `engine_tags` is the REAL verdict from running `quire validate --scope . "spec/**/*.md"` (quire 0.32.2, cli d61afb23, engine 0.46.0@acd1be63) against each repo's actual spec tree -- not imitated. Empty `engine_tags` means the owning document reported zero [grammar] findings of any kind in that run, not just zero ears: ones. This is NOT a human-labelled corpus; there is no ground truth beyond the engine's own mechanical output, which is exactly what M6 measures Jev's independent judgment against.
engine_naive_pattern_method: Mechanically derived from each statement's leading trigger clause per FR-042's own documented rule (see this script's engine_naive_pattern()), NOT read from `quire validate`'s internal parser output -- the CLI does not expose a per-statement pattern label, only the [ears:*] finding codes. `engine_tags` (empty means clean) IS the real, measured `quire validate` output; `engine_naive_pattern` is this harness's own auditable approximation of what pattern the engine's rule would assign, used only to detect Jev's disagreement with the keyword the engine actually reads.
